li.label: the first fruit in the sun
li.description: We all walked out into the noon light and ate the first fruit of the year where it grew, and nobody asked for anything. It tasted like summer.

li.label: the sun came back
li.description: After the longest night we stood out in the cold and watched the sun come up, and it lay on us gold for a while.

plain.li: [lookback] The sun is staring right at us today, after yesterday.
[lookback] I can't look up, the whole sky is white with it.
[lookback] The shadows haven't moved since noon, and the stones are too hot to touch.
[lookback,named] {GOD} is looking back after the moon got in his way.
[lookback,scoffer] A hot day after a cold one, it's only the weather.
[fruit] Eat it here where it grew, that's how it's done.
[fruit] The first of the year, and the sun is on all of us alike.
[fruit,named] Nothing for {GOD}, he never wants anything, just eat it in his light.
[fruit,scoffer] Fine, it's a good excuse to sit in the sun.
[dawn] There it is, it came back after all.
[dawn] Look how gold it is on the snow.
[dawn,afterwalk] Whatever walked out there last night, the sun is up now.
[dawn,named] {GOD} came back, the longest night is over.
[dawn,scoffer] The sun rises every morning, I don't see why we're all out here.
